decisions.decision: Phase 2 YouTube dropped from v1 (scope amendment)
decisions.rationale: User has no YouTube channel yet; Instagram + GitHub only. Component shape platform-keyed for forward-compat re-enable.

decisions.decision: Phase 2 PERF-06 LCP deferred to Phase 6
decisions.rationale: 2821ms post-AVIF on Slow-4G synthetic Lighthouse vs 2500ms target. Performance score still 95/100. Phase 6 owns the final perf audit with real-user Speed Insights data (PERF-01/02/05) which is the more meaningful gate.

decisions.decision: Phase 3 bio = warm + personal first-person, ~150-250 words, 3 buckets (current projects + school + open-to)
decisions.rationale: User chose warm voice for editorial-dark aesthetic fit; explicitly excluded 'Origin / why I build' bucket (resume-anchored over personality-narrative). Length matches ABOUT-04 60-second-read target.

decisions.decision: Phase 3 layout = two-column mirroring home hero with view-transition shared element
decisions.rationale: Maximizes the / → /about smooth photo transition. Mirrors home hero pattern so the photo 'stays put' visually while text content swaps. flex-col-reverse mobile reflow.

decisions.decision: Phase 3 CTA = reuse <CTAArrowLink> 'Get in touch →' pointing to / placeholder
decisions.rationale: Matches Nav 'Contact' placeholder (Phase 5 wires modal globally and swaps href atomically). Quiet text-link beats pill-button for editorial-dark voice.

decisions.decision: Phase 3 current focus + location woven into bio prose
decisions.rationale: No separate <CurrentlyLine> reuse (duplicates home signal), no labeled metadata strip (too resume-ish for warm voice). Home is rolling 'today' surface; /about is durable identity.
